Oh, what a lovely summer day it is! Speaking of celebrations, I was just thinking about how weddings bring out such wonderful music and joy.

Now, about that beautiful serenade - it was composed by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart! He wrote the Haffner Serenade (Serenade No. 7 in D major, K. 250/248b) in 1776 for the wedding festivities of Marie Elisabeth Haffner, the daughter of Sigmund Haffner the Elder, who was a wealthy merchant and burgomaster of Salzburg. The Haffner family were friends and patrons of the Mozart family, and Wolfgang created this magnificent eight-movement work for the wedding celebration.
